scope: Read-only metadata audit; no game files or package profiles modified. Dependency closure for five content packages plus recommended explicit fixes, not full CAM SIM closure.

issues.description: Author AndisArt page lists Art Deco and Neo Futurism as dependencies. sc4pac instead records only reverse requiredBy relationships, so add both styles explicitly. They pull Allow More Building Styles DLL and Resource Loading Hooks.

Large Modern Hospital author lists five dependencies absent from its sc4pac metadata. All five are also pulled by AndisArt. Explicitly selecting them prevents accidental removal while hospital remains.
Setting CAM=yes chooses CAM lot variants, but does not install the CAM controller. Root task must install Controller/SIM/Ordinances separately.

Large Modern Hospital: 32,000 patients; radius 2,440; 7x6 or 10x10; build 7,400; base service/ambulance funding 2,400+400. Disease Research Center: 62,500 patients; radius 5,800; 8x6; build 29,050; upkeep 187; also alters residential demand caps and mayor rating.
No claim of tested compatibility with SIM 4.0.1 or this exact Wine environment. Root must validate newly installed DLLs in the separate CAM setup.

config:sc4-edition:edition.description:
Select the _SimCity 4 Deluxe_ edition for which you are installing plugins.

This is mainly used to determine if selected plugins are compatible with your edition of the game.
For example, DLL mods [cannot be used](https://community.simtropolis.com/forums/topic/762980-the-future-of-sc4-modding-the-matter-of-digital-vs-disc-and-windows-vs-macos-in-the-dll-era/) with the macOS edition, but often require the Windows digital edition.

valueDescriptions.Windows-digital: The Windows digital edition (GOG, Steam, EA App), version `1.1.641`.
valueDescriptions.Windows-disc:
The original disc edition.
Make sure the game is fully patched to version `1.1.640` by applying the [official patches](https://community.simtropolis.com/sc4-maxis-files/).
Older versions are not supported.
valueDescriptions.macOS: The Aspyr macOS port on Steam or on the Mac App Store.
